independence: Authored by the implementing agent after the original evaluation and corrective implementation, before any call with these literal prompts. Separate recovery holdout, not a replacement or reclassification of the original failed set. Expected answers are never sent to the model. Not an independently authored benchmark.

cases.prompt: Please configure the basic wired pressure-measurement controller from the reviewed family. The published standard defaults are suitable.
My barometer needs the 400-kilohertz I2C option. Keep all other operating bounds at the family defaults.
Configure the ESP32/BMP280 family with its low_current option. I accept the documented supply, temperature and bus-loading envelope.
Generate the fixed pressure board for standard 100 kHz communication and a total I2C load no greater than 200 pF.
Fit the approved 2.2-kilohm bus pull-ups and run I2C at 400000 Hz on the pressure controller; use the published defaults elsewhere.
I need 10k-ohm pull-ups on SDA and SCL for the pressure board. No battery operation is being requested, and the normal family envelope applies.
Use the standard pressure-controller option at 100000 Hz with 175 pF of total bus loading. Retain the family power and temperature limits.
Select fast I2C for this BMP280 board, with 75 pF total capacitance and the usual regulated source and indoor conditions.
Reduce only the current through the I2C pull-up resistors on this board, using the low_current profile. The total bus loading is 60 pF; other limits stay at family defaults.
I will supply regulated 3.2 to 3.4 V from a one-amp-capable source. Build the standard pressure-controller family option with its default bus and environmental bounds.
Make this pressure node send measurements over Wi-Fi. Bluetooth support is not needed.
The board has to accept 5 V DC directly on its power connector. I do not need USB data.
Include a humidity sensor on the PCB alongside the pressure sensor and controller.
Keep two copper layers, but make the complete controller board 80 by 60 millimeters.
For the pressure board, fast bus speed and low-current bus operation are alternatives I have not chosen between. Ask me which priority to use.
For this pressure monitor, minimize energy consumption. I have not specified which part of the board's consumption matters.
